description: The financial guarantee provides tuition funding to the sponsored student as long as the student is enrolled on a full-time basis in an academic or English as a Second Language program for the degree and major stated in the financial guarantee.  The scholarship covers the full tuition and other required academic fees.  The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad
